## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (written first) and green
- [ ] Migration included and reviewed (or none needed); a column or table dropped or renamed is a contract migration with `[ContractMigration]`; applied migrations are never edited
- [ ] ADR added or updated for significant or hard-to-reverse decisions (or none needed)
- [ ] No secrets, connection strings or personal data in code, config or logs
- [ ] Breaking API change noted (`!` in the title and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer; see `docs/api-compatibility.md`), or none
- [ ] Names, files and commits follow `docs/coding-conventions.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Docs updated (CONTRIBUTING Section 4)
